servicesList.name: Earthquake Resistant Construction
servicesList.summary: Lightweight wall panel and steel frame systems engineered to absorb seismic shocks and minimize structural deflection.
servicesList.content: Our earthquake-resistant structural solutions feature lightweight Smart Panels interlocking directly with precision-engineered steel frames. By reducing the overall building weight by over 60% compared to traditional brick masonry, base shear forces during an earthquake are dramatically decreased. Every installation conforms to the Nepal National Building Code for active seismic zones.

servicesList.name: Smart Sandwich Panel Installation
servicesList.summary: Tongue-and-groove EPS core panels with 4.5mm calcium silicate boards for walls, partitions, and exterior envelopes.
servicesList.content: Smart Sandwich Panels combine an EPS-and-cement core wrapped in 4.5mm calcium silicate board on both faces. Featuring tongue-and-groove interlocking edges, every panel locks tightly into the next for fast on-site installation, clean finish, and exceptional thermal and sound barrier performance.

servicesList.name: Smart Solid Panel Wall Systems
servicesList.summary: Mesh-reinforced solid panels plastered after installation for heavy-duty structural durability and impact resistance.
servicesList.content: Smart Solid Panels are manufactured from expanded polystyrene beads, cement, sand, water, and specialized bonding agents, reinforced with internal mesh for added tensile strength. Ideal for high-traffic buildings, schools, and commercial facilities requiring a traditional plastered aesthetic with prefab speed.

servicesList.name: Turnkey Prefab Residential & Commercial Homes
servicesList.summary: Complete prefabricated residential homes and commercial buildings constructed in 7 to 15 days.
servicesList.content: We manufacture and assemble complete turnkey prefab houses using Smart Panels. From architectural blueprints and foundation design to panel erection, roofing, and finishing, our turnkey solution delivers safe, earthquake-ready homes in a fraction of traditional construction time.

servicesList.name: Smart EPS Construction Blocks
servicesList.summary: Ultra-lightweight OPC cement & EPS molded blocks for partition walls, floor infills, and insulation layers.
servicesList.content: Lightweight construction blocks made from EPS beads, OPC cement, water, and essential additives, molded into precise dimensions (100×200×600mm, 150×200×600mm, 200×200×600mm). Superior thermal insulation and easy handling on construction sites without heavy machinery.

servicesList.name: Wall & Roof Insulation Systems
servicesList.summary: Complete insulated wall cladding and roofing systems tailored for schools, hospitals, resorts, and commercial complexes.
servicesList.content: We supply and install complete building envelopes, including insulated sandwich wall systems, fire-rated ceiling panels, and temperature-controlled roof cladding designed to withstand harsh monsoon rains and winter cold across Nepal.

faqs.question: What is Smart Panel and what is it made of?
faqs.answer: Smart Panel is a lightweight, interlocking prefabricated panel manufactured by Prefab Panel Nepal Pvt. Ltd. Our flagship panel wraps an EPS beads, cement, sand, and bonding agent core in 4.5mm non-asbestos calcium silicate boards on both faces. Tongue-and-groove edges allow panels to lock together quickly for airtight, fireproof, and insulated construction.

faqs.question: What are the approved Government District Rate List prices for Smart Panel?
faqs.answer: Smart Panel is officially listed on the Government District Rate List with transparent rates: 50mm at NPR 191/sq. ft., 60mm at NPR 293/sq. ft., 75mm at NPR 351/sq. ft., 90/100mm at NPR 410/sq. ft., and 120mm at NPR 495/sq. ft. Standard installation is NPR 26/sq. ft. and accessories are NPR 47/sq. ft.

faqs.question: Where is the Smart Panel factory and corporate office located?
faqs.answer: Our state-of-the-art manufacturing plant is located at Darai Tole-8, Bharatpur, Chitwan, backed by an NPR 20 crore investment with an annual capacity of 150,000 sq. ft. Our corporate headquarters is located at Pepsicola-32, Madhyapur Thimi, Nepal.

faqs.question: Why is Smart Panel superior for earthquake safety in Nepal?
faqs.answer: A lighter wall means significantly less seismic inertial force acts upon the building during ground shaking. Smart Panels reduce wall dead load by over 60%, drastically reducing base shear and structural deflection, making buildings far safer in earthquake zones.

faqs.question: What are the differences between Smart Sandwich Panel, Solid Panel, and EPS Block?
faqs.answer: Smart Sandwich Panels feature smooth 4.5mm calcium silicate board skins on both sides and require no plastering. Smart Solid Panels are mesh-reinforced for added impact resistance and plastered after installation. Smart EPS Blocks are lightweight blocks (100/150/200 × 200 × 600mm) used for partition walls and floor infills.

faqs.question: What tools are needed for on-site Smart Panel installation?
faqs.answer: Installation requires no heavy cranes. A crew uses five standard tools: Cutting Machine (clean trims), Drill Machine (fast fixings), Welding Machine (frame & joint securing), Thread Hand Drill (fine adjustments), and Plumb Bob (ensures panels are perfectly vertical).

faqs.question: How fire-resistant and soundproof is Smart Panel?
faqs.answer: Smart Panels have a certified fire proof time limit of ≥3 hours (for 50mm) and ≥4 hours (for 75mm, 100mm, and 120mm). Sound insulation capacity ranges from ≥35 dB to ≥45 dB, providing high acoustic privacy.
